text: Diego wants this scoped pi-mcp-adapter fork published to npm so The Last Harness can install it via exact npm pins instead of checking out the repository during installer runs; the motivation is faster TLH installation.

Diego decided this fork should follow a non-rebase upstream intake model adapted from pi-subagents: review/adopt upstream by release/tag or coherent feature cluster, integrate via explicit merge or squash-import PRs, and record each intake in .upstream-ledger.jsonl with the git DAG plus ledger treated as authoritative. He explicitly rejected blind per-commit sync/replay and any baseline that would imply post-v2.10.0 upstream adoption without a real intake record. The initial ledger baseline is informational only and marks v2.10.0 as the historical fork base for future intake work.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>
